description: Every act that a client can show around the face of an agent while it works. A stage and a tool name acts by key in their `acts`.

acts.title: Writing
acts.description: A page of a few lines rises at the lower left of the face and a pen moves at its bottom.

acts.title: Reading
acts.description: Lines of text float down and up at the two sides of the face while the eyes go from one to the other.

acts.title: Searching
acts.description: A magnifying glass, turned to face the other way, floats up at the right of the face and pulses, with a globe at its upper right and a library at its lower right.

acts.title: Analyzing
acts.description: A curve, a few columns and lines of text go round the face on one flat ring while it thinks.

acts.title: Asking
acts.description: A single question mark wiggles beside the face.

acts.title: Coding
acts.description: Brackets and symbols of code fly up to the upper right while the face taps at a laptop at its lower right.

acts.title: Calculating
acts.description: Numbers and signs rise in three ways from above the face, straight up and slanting to each side, while its eyes go from one to the next.

acts.title: Planning
acts.description: A chart of tasks, a board and a list of events go round the face on one flat ring.

acts.title: Fetching
acts.description: A pile of documents floats above the face while a tray receives an arrow beside it.

acts.title: Reviewing
acts.description: Lines of text come in turn at the left of the face, above it and below it, while a magnifying glass sweeps slowly across the face.

acts.title: Comparing
acts.description: Lines of text sweep at the two sides of the face with two boxes that move apart above it.

acts.title: Saving
acts.description: A tray with an arrow ticks while a tick is drawn beside the face.

acts.title: Typing
acts.description: The face bobs gently while it types on a laptop at its lower right, and words fly up and away to the upper right.

acts.title: Interviewing
acts.description: A second agent faces the face; speech bubbles that point opposite ways come in turn between them, with a question mark by the first.

acts.title: Summarizing
acts.description: Lines of text come in toward the face from all round it, one after another.

acts.title: Linking
acts.description: A thick line is drawn from one solid dot to another over the chin, and the dots light up; a node at the right of the face branches into two.

acts.title: Exporting
acts.description: A file at the left of the face is zipped shut while a pile of documents fans out at its right.
